verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an in-product AI that answers plain-language questions across all your data ([amplitude-docs-10]). It also offers conversational, expert-level answers that can be shared across the org without SQL or dashboard setup ([amplitude-docs-34]), which covers the core of getting AI-generated insights inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (not just answers to questions), in-depth documentation of what the AI analyzes or produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
